title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Acme VPN Gateway Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Acme VPN Gateway contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability that has been exploited in the wild to deploy ransomware.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Contoso Mail Server Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Contoso Mail Server contains an authentication bypass vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access mailboxes without credentials.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Initech Directory Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Initech Directory Server contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that has been exploited in the wild.
